Identify any instances in bet.html, race.html, or the related static JavaScript files where user-provided snail names are inserted into the DOM via innerHTML or similar methods, or sent to backend endpoints with elevated privileges. Analyze these locations for potential XSS sinks, CSRF vulnerabilities, or application logic flaws that could allow users to perform actions as operators. Provide specific evidence or examples of such security risks if found.
